preconditions.description: L and R are integers such that 1 <= L <= R <= 10^10^6

postconditions.expression: sum(c_i for t_i, c_i in S) == m
postconditions.description: The sum of all c_i in the compressed sequence S equals the number of segments m

postconditions.expression: all(t_i != t_{i+1} for i in range(len(S) - 1))
postconditions.description: Consecutive t_i in the compressed sequence S are distinct

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= t_i for t_i, c_i in S)
postconditions.description: All t_i in the compressed sequence S are non-negative

postconditions.expression: all(c_i >= 1 for t_i, c_i in S)
postconditions.description: All c_i in the compressed sequence S are positive

postconditions.expression: all(l_i <= r_i for l_i, r_i in segments)
postconditions.description: Each segment [l_i, r_i] in the sequence of segments is valid

postconditions.expression: all(l_i == R or r_i == L for l_i, r_i in segments if l_i != r_i)
postconditions.description: Segments in the sequence connect end-to-end from L to R

postconditions.expression: all(l_i == i * 10**(2**(t_i-1)) + 1 and r_i == (i + 1) * 10**(2**(t_i-1)) for t_i, c_i in S for i in range(c_i) for l_i, r_i in segments if segments.index([l_i, r_i]) == sum(c_j for t_j, c_j in S[:S.index([t_i, c_i])]) + i)
postconditions.description: Each segment [l_i, r_i] belongs to the corresponding level t_i of the square-ten tree
